title: Bounded retries: 429, 503 and timeout
requirement: The local service returns 429 then 503 before succeeding on attempt 3 for each page. Retry GET at most three times; transient attempts are evidence, not final defects. A permanent failure or timeout counts one final status violation plus missing keys. Inspect Retry-After and attempt evidence. Limits are fixed: 10 pages, 3 attempts/page, 50–300 ms/request.
learning_objectives: Use actual HTTP evidence to distinguish transport and data defects.
